paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Charsha of Ginosar asked Rabban Gamliel and the sages at Yavneh: Jerusalem Talmud, Maaserot 1:2. Rabbi Yose said: ‘Yonatan ben Charsha of Ginosar asked before the elders at Yavneh’: Tosefta, Kelim, Bava Batra, chapter 5.
